meta.name: crosspost
meta.description: Multi-platform content distribution across X, LinkedIn, Threads, and Bluesky. Adapts content per platform using content-engine patterns. Never posts identical content cross-platform. Use when the user wants to distribute content across social platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容分发到多个社交平台并自动适配
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个社交平台同步发布内容并保持风格适配
copy.tagline_en: Distribute content across multiple social platforms with automatic adaptation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to publish content across multiple social platforms with platform-specific adaptation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的原始内容，为 X、LinkedIn、Threads、Bluesky 等平台分别改写适配版本，确保各平台内容不同但保留你的语气。
howto.when: 当你说“跨平台发布”、“把这个发到所有平台”或要求为 X 和 LinkedIn 适配内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇博客改写成 X 和 LinkedIn 的帖子。
say.note: Claude 会生成两个平台的适配版本。

say.text: 跨平台发布这个产品更新。
say.note: Claude 会为各平台生成不同版本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adapts your source content for X, LinkedIn, Threads, and Bluesky, creating platform-specific versions that preserve your voice without duplicating copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "crosspost", "post this everywhere", or ask to adapt content for X and LinkedIn.

say_en.text: Adapt this blog post for X and LinkedIn.

say_en.note: Claude creates adapted versions for each platform.
